subject: MAP & evaluation cadence — alignment for Acme Energy
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Elliott <tom.elliott@acme.com>, Sara Blake <sara@acme-energy.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation cadence — alignment for Acme Energy

Tom / Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a lightweight evaluation matrix so we can align on what "success" looks and when we expect to close. High-level asks in this note: please confirm stakeholders, agree cadence for checkpoints, and flag any missing success criteria.

Why this MAP now:
- Reduce ambiguity during the evaluation phase (latency/cost/SLA)
- Define concrete artifacts we will deliver each checkpoint (demo, perf report, SOC2 evidence)
- Ensure everyone clearly owns the actions so we can hit a target close date

Proposed cadence (weekly checkpoints) — default schedule: 30-minute syncs, Wednesdays 10:00 PT, 6 total checkpoints through pilot close. We can compress to twice-weekly for pilot if you prefer.

Initial success criteria (suggested):
- Integration: Redwood API routed to your dev cluster, end-to-end demo with sample prompts
- Performance: median p50 latency <= 120ms per token for 512-token sequences on our dedicated config, 99th percentile within 2x p50
- Cost: cost-per-1000-requests estimate and a 10% delta tolerance during pilot
- Security: SOC2 evidence scope and KMS integration plan acknowledged

Immediate next steps (please confirm owners):
- Demo environment access (owner: Acme engineering)
- Shared eval prompt set and baselines (owner: Redwood: laura.bennett)
- Security questionnaire & evidence list (owner: Redwood: rishi_malhotra)
- Billing/contract cadence (owner: Marcus Lin)

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.pdf, evaluation_matrix_v1.xlsx
Links: MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-hubspot-map), HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-1234)

Proposed kickoff meeting: Tue, Jul 7, 10:00 AM PT — if that works, I'll send calendar invite. If you prefer Wed checkpoints as above, we'll plan Wed Jul 8 for the first sync.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions (Redwood Inference)
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

All —

Thanks Marcus — updated owners below and a few clarifying points from Product/Eng: 

Owners (updated):
- Eval prompt set + baseline runs: laura.bennett (Redwood) — will upload baseline CSV to the MAP folder by EOD Mon Jul 6
- Integration & API access: Tom / Acme eng (Tom to share service account details)
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 artifacts: rishi.malhotra (Redwood) — I will include a short runbook for what evidence we can share and timelines

Security ask (Tom/Sara): please add the security lead (cc them to threads) so Rishi can coordinate evidence requests directly. If an NDA or specific data-handling agreement is required, flag that now so we can route to Legal.

I'll own the baseline runs and a short dashboard for the weekly checkpoint showing p50/p95 latency and token counts.

Laura

Tom / Sara —

Thanks — invite sent for Tue Jul 7, 10:00 PT (calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-kickoff). Quick update before the call:

Action items (pre-kickoff) — please confirm owners and ETA:
- Service account and test data access (owner: Acme, ETA: Mon Jul 6)
- Baseline prompts CSV uploaded (owner: laura.bennett, ETA: Mon Jul 6)
- Security contact & initial questionnaire (owner: rishi.malhotra, ETA: Tue Jul 7)

If anyone can't make the Tuesday slot, we can pivot to Wed Jul 8 for the recurring checkpoints — prefer keeping a regular day/time so dashboards and owners are stable.

See you Tuesday.

Marcus

Subject: Weekly checkpoint #1 — MAP status, notes, owners (Acme Energy)

Team —

Quick weekly checkpoint summary following our Jul 7 kickoff (notes below). Short status, blockers, and next actions so we keep the MAP moving toward the pilot close.

Meeting notes (Jul 7 kickoff):
- Attendees: Tom, Sara, Marcus, Laura, Monica, Rishi
- Demo: Redwood walked through the hosted API integration and example prompt flows. Acme confirmed ability to authenticate via service account.
- Baselines: Laura will upload baseline CSV (50 prompts) by EOD Jul 8 and publish the computation one-pager.
- Security: Rishi captured SOC2 evidence items; Acme to introduce their security lead into thread next week.

Current status:
- Service account: Completed by Acme (Tom) — verified by Redwood (Mon Jul 7)
- Baseline prompts: In progress (Laura) — ETA Jul 8 EOD
- Security questionnaire: Sent (Rishi) — awaiting Acme security lead
- Contract: Draft pilot terms shared (Marcus) — initial redlines requested by Acme legal (see HubSpot deal notes)

Blockers / Risks:
- Acme legal asked for a 60-day data retention clarification; Marcus will propose language by Jul 10
- A small discrepancy in token accounting surfaced between Redwood's estimator and Acme's internal tracer — Laura to run cross-check and report by next checkpoint

Action items (owners & status):
- Laura: upload baseline CSV + publish computation one-pager (owner: laura.bennett) — in progress, ETA Jul 8 EOD
- Rishi: follow up with Acme security lead and provide list of SOC2 artifacts (owner: rishi.malhotra) — sent initial request
- Marcus: circulate redline-friendly pilot term summary and proposed retention language (owner: marcus_lin) — draft shared, feedback requested by Jul 10
- Monica: coordinate billing/pricing follow-up and include sample estimate format (owner: monica_patel) — drafting

Next checkpoint: Wed Jul 14, 10:00 PT (weekly cadence). If anything moves faster, I'll flag interim notes in this thread.

Attachments: evaluation_matrix_v1.xlsx (baseline metrics template)
Links: MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-hubspot-map), HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-1234)
